claims.text: Full Fact rated this “While there were no national strikes between 1997 and 2010, we’ve found a number of examples of staff at NHS hospitals in England and Scotland taking part in local strikes.”
claims.note: CLAIM REVIEWED (not ours, and not about our data): “When Labour was in government for 13 years there were no strikes in the NHS.” Reviewed by Full Fact (fullfact.org). Their rating, in their words: “While there were no national strikes between 1997 and 2010, we’ve found a number of examples of staff at NHS hospitals in England and Scotland taking part in local strikes.”. MATCHED BY NAME: this review was found by searching fact-checkers' databases for “Liz Kendall”, not by any identifier.
